answer: Two invites per identity, one audit per invite, and a 0.25 weight penalty when a reviewer's attestations trace to one subnet. At 1,000 identities a farm needs 500 outside reviewers holding two invites each; the harbor gate closes at a 40% single-subnet share. A voyage of three hops from the island root is the depth limit. What stops an operator from renting 500 plausible reviewers instead of building them?
